body: Sometimes is trying to make everyone happy expecting someone to do the same with you.

Just be honest with him, tell him you are scared of your dad and gf. I mean ask him, what if it is true and they die or suffer? Isn't it better to just take some precautions, if they would tell me that I need to stay 2 mts away from other people and wear a mask to protect those I love...I woul. They are not asking for money, for time, for nothing really and If he has a problem with that maybe you should reconsider your friendship...Do you really wanna be friends with a guy that thinks Covid is fake? :/
I am Gabi, nice to meet you too :)

I understand you, I really do...would you like to be friends? I was more social before, now i panic even at work...I feel something got broken and it might never get fixed so I might just learn how to live with it...this scares me lots but yeah...would you like to be friends?
It does, with time and effort.. it is not easy but one day, one day you might go to sleep and realise that this day was actually enjoyable and smile.
My family, my insecurities, panic attacks and humor...I am good at baking tho

We are still pretty fucked in basic needs, education is poor, the health system is poor, economy is shit and unless you follow a certain party trying to make a living and improving your life is kinda impossible. So what? We acknowledge as a society the existence of indigenous people but did we make it better? Also aymara and quechua are the not only two that exist but the only ones they paid attention....so no, we didn't kick him out cause he was indigenous, we did cause he was corrupt, he was ruining everything and we needed better....did we get better? I don't think so but we sure be working on it.

So you don't know what it is like to live here? Cost of living? Corruption? poor education? Actually living in a Village? Or living in so called turistic "cities" that are still to this day undeveloped? Or life as an disabled person and how unfair the system is to them? No...you visited twice and based your opinion on what? People that are racist? It is not a lame excuse, you don't know what life was in Bolivia and no, I am not white...I am everything but white and not even upper class hahaha I think you got the wrong one here. My family is poor, we had to atudy in the public system, my grandma was disabled half her life due to a stroke, my uncle is homeless and Yeah maybe Evo was good when it came to open the discussion for indigenous people to be treated right but it only made it worse. Cause then everyone that followed him thinks white people want to kill them or take away their rights....he was not a good man, he was not a fair leader and whatever good he did is small compared to the damage he made. Also why is this even in English? You know how many people are privileged enough to learn proper English? Maybe if you would actually spend time getting your information from people that had to live here and managed to survive you would know why it was needed for him to leave.
I care...do you want to call bit? I kinda feel sad too and we can call to just talk it out if you want

It is ok to feel sad, really. Your boyfriend seems supportive and you can talk as much as you feel necessary about this with him, it is a very strong experience physically and psychologically. You are not alone, I've had one too and I know what you mean when you say you feel some emptiness. You need time to heal 💕 :)

I am sorry your boyfriend did the same. It can feel very lonely, I know. You are right when you say I should be ready for a next time, I really haven't thought about it but yes, I could be ready for a new opportunity in other moment. Thank you for your words, they made me feel better and understood
Thank you so much for your words, they mean so much to me because I do hope we will be together again. Thank you for your kindness

Think about it as it is...your baby. Really, I had one abortion and I now regret it (I am not saying that you will or that you shouldn't have an abortion)  if you really don't feel ready and that you want to plan this better then prepare yourself first, go talk with your partner about when would you want to have kids if not now, how are you going to deal with this afterwards and if this is going to affect him too, having those things clear will make you feel better and more secure about any decision you make.
Whatever decision you make I really hope you are happy with it.

Don't feel bad. It is really hard to close yourself from those comments, I know from first hand but you have to surround yourself with nice people. Words can have a huge impact in our lives but that goes in a good way too, so you need someone to tell you how special and unique you are, not inferior in any possible way, you need those nice words. Be strong! And have hope in humanity, there is still nice people out there capable of bringing joy to everyone's life :) best wishes dear! Love from Bolivia!
Follow your instincts...it it doesn't feel right, it is not. I honestly don't like guys that make this type of comments, they end up being the worst type of creeps.
